subject: Chemistry - AQA

coverage_decisions.decision: Reviewed all three PMT summaries. Study Rocket has no standalone Chemical analysis topic in this AQA index, so its separation page supplies only overlapping chromatography; official 8462 requirements control gas, ion and instrumental coverage. Retained every gas/flame/hydroxide/anion result and diagram. Added Rf comparison, observation versus inference, combined ion identification and calibrated measurement. Rejected the claim that a pure substance always forms one spot in every possible solvent.
